leads.title: BBC repos relocated to Codeberg
leads.detail: audiowaveform and peaks.js READMEs state ongoing development moved to codeberg.org/chrisn/* (S01/S03). GitHub repos may freeze; if the waveform format spec evolves, pin the Codeberg commits instead. Affects: format reference stability only.

leads.title: audiowaveform license text unverified
leads.detail: README says 'See COPYING' (S01); the license text was not fetched this session. We reuse the documented format, not code, so blocking risk is low — verify before any derivative-format naming or code reference.

leads.title: peaks.js #530 fix commit + regression test untraced
leads.detail: Issue closed 2024-06-28 (S13) but the fixing commit/release was not identified within budget. Do not cite #530 as a fixed-behavior precedent without tracing it; current use is as a rounding-class lesson only.

leads.title: libsndfile >2s-seek regression test coverage after PR #709
leads.detail: PR #709 added no test file (S08); whether a later commit added a long-seek regression test is unknown. Directly motivates our own W3 suite; check libsndfile tests/ history before trusting fixed-version seek behavior in any codec.

leads.title: FLAC/MP3 sample-exact seek guarantees
leads.detail: The #643 chain is Vorbis-specific; no evidence gathered that FLAC (seektable-dependent) or MP3 seeks are sample-exact across versions. Bounded design answer already in place (verified PCM proxies + import sanity probe), but per-version verification remains open.

leads.title: whisper.cpp offline transcription cost on 8 GB laptop
leads.detail: Opportunity (proposal §10): draft cues via whisper.cpp. CPU/RAM time for 2 h audio unmeasured; model-size/memory tradeoffs need a bounded experiment before any commitment.

leads.title: Resampler selection: libsamplerate vs scipy.signal.resample_poly
leads.detail: Review-tier resampling quality, licensing, and speed not benchmarked by us. Decision deferred with a declared-quality fallback (proposal §5, §10 item 3).

leads.title: Audio output backend latency (PySide6/Qt on Linux)
leads.detail: Scrub latency target (<50 ms) unmeasured; alternative sink (SDL2/miniaudio) identified. Investigation target only.

leads.title: AAC/M4A decode path if field recordings arrive as such
leads.detail: Out of v1 boundary (§2). Plausible bounded path: FFmpeg subprocess importer producing a verified PCM proxy, source untouched. Requirements work only if oral-history partners actually deliver M4A.

leads.title: Audacity 4 (.aup4/.aud4) format developments
leads.detail: Search results show active Audacity 4 project-file bugs (S10/S11 captures include AU4 issues; e.g., #11976 unicode filename handling, closed 2026-09-15). Worth a re-check before finalizing exchange-format guidance; no design dependency.

leads.title: Cue-table export scope behavior
leads.detail: Audacity #1552 (S12) shows label export ignoring selection. Our contract says export honors explicit scope; add an automated UI-level check to the (UNEXECUTED) W6 drill.

negative_findings.result: 1 unrelated open feature request (#58, S15); no defect chain found via this query. No claim of absence beyond the query.
